model.notes: Qwen2.5-7B base (not Instruct); the Hugging Face repository Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B is the base model.

metrics.evaluation_scope: Full benchmark test sets (gsm8k 1319, math 5000, minerva_math 272, gaokao2024_mix 91, olympiadbench 675, amc23 40, aime24 30, aime25 30). Baseline is untrained Qwen2.5-7B base; final is the same model fine-tuned on the 3,000-row dataset selected by DataFlow-Evolver. Both measured under identical generation settings. The 10% diagnostic subset used for in-loop feedback is reported separately under diagnostic_subset and is not the headline metric.

reference_systems.note: Comparable systems evaluated under the same protocol. math3k_original and math3k_gpt4o_rewrite are 3,000-row math SFT datasets from DataFlow-Instruct-10K, trained and evaluated identically; qwen25_7b_instruct is the released instruct model shown as an external reference, not a controlled comparison.

diagnostic_subset.note: 10% per-benchmark sample at seed 42, materialised before evolution. This is the in-loop feedback signal the method optimised against, not an evaluation result. Full test sets never entered the optimisation loop.

settings.compute_budget: 8x A100-80GB SXM (driver 535.129.03), GPU 7 reserved for the embedding service. Pipeline evolution 12,717s (3.53h) across 5 iterations; each downstream checkpoint added ~1,030-1,110s for SFT plus diagnostic-subset evaluation; embedding review 577s total. ~30h end-to-end including post-hoc full-test-set evaluation. Tokens: 88.36M pipeline teacher (gpt-4o, 87,315 requests), 9.25M pipeline agent (Codex + gpt-5.6-sol effort xhigh, 73% cached input), 8.82M embedding (Qwen3-Embedding-8B, 15,000 requests), 0.22M ReviewAgent (gpt-5.6-sol, 7 requests); 106.65M total.

evaluation_harness.name: Qwen2.5-Math
deviations: math_eval.py: data-parallel sharding flags; --max_model_len; --seed forwarded to vllm.LLM; stop token IDs resolved from the tokenizer instead of hard-coded; per-sample finish_reason and output token counts recorded; empty-shard handling; qwen25-math-cot rejected with --apply_chat_template
parser.py: aime25 added to the ground-truth extraction branch shared with aime24
grader.py and evaluate.py: grading logic unchanged (grader.py byte-identical)
